label: end-of-episode clock (last ~8 trials), D1/D2 only
explanation: Episode-time unit: never active before trial ~60, rare before 85; 95% of activation mass falls in trials 90-99 (rate 27% there vs 0 earlier). Within that window it fires on D1 and D2 steps and is almost silent at GO (1% of mass). Equivalently tracks the model value head being low (96% of mass at value < 5.22, the bottom quantile), consistent with value falling as the episode horizon runs out; (value < 4.5) & non-GO scores about the same (F1 0.62). Precision within the late window is only ~0.5: not every late D1/D2 step fires. Magnitude is larger at D2 than D1 and the largest activations occur late in episodes where the agent keeps choosing the action leading to the bad state (S1 reached while S2 is good, unrewarded streaks), but a conjunction with choice/state/reward did not improve F1, so that is only a qualitative magnitude observation. Uses only observable/internal quantities (episode time), no future variables.
